title: DirAccess.Rename and DirAccess.RenameAbsolute fails when trying to overwrite directory
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.5.1.stable.mono.official [f62fdbde1]

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable.mono - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8180) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-8700 CPU @ 3.20GHz (12 threads) - 15.92 GiB memory

### Issue description

DirAccess.Rename and DirAccess.RenameAbsolute fails with Error.Failed when trying to overwrite an existing directory, no matter if it is empty or not.

The documentation for DirAccess.Rename says 'If the destination file or directory exists and is not access-protected, it will be overwritten.', so it sounds like it should overwrite, or the documentation is incorrect.

Looking at the code in dir_access_windows.cpp, it seems there are multiple issues:
- DirAccessWindows::rename only checks DirAccessWindows::file_exists and not DirAccessWindows::dir_exists, so it will only try to remove existing files and not directories
- DirAccessWindows::remove only supports removing empty directories, which is also documented in DirAccess.rename

I also found this proposal that might make sense to complete if DirAccess.rename is changed to recursively delete files:https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/11598

### Steps to reproduce

- Call DirAccess.Rename or DirAccess.RenameAbsolute with an existing destination directory
- See it returns Error.Failed

Reproduction project:
- Run the project
- See in the user data folder that 'renamed_dir' hasn't been renamed to 'non-empty-dir' and both still exist
- See in the console that 'Error: 1' was printed, meaning DirAccess.RenameAbsolute returned Error.Failed

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[dir-access-rename-bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24279643/dir-access-rename-bug.zip)
